The close alignment of normalized Laplacian eigenvalues indicates preservation of global execution structure under synthesis, while visible variance reflects stochastic generation and rare-path amplification.

Figure 1: Overview of LogSynthFSM. The system converts raw logs into an execution-aware multi-relational representation, synthesizes realistic traces guided by an inferred statemachine, and improves downstream anomaly detection through structurepreserving data generation.
